profile_boundary.cpp_lowering: std::int32_t arithmetic is safe only because the authenticated left operand is nonnegative and count is 0..4

materialization.description: mask result initializes local int bit, then the sole float(bit) construct is returned

range_proof.row: local row initializes to 0; all 40 later writes are authenticated literal assignments in 4..31
range_proof.shift_result: immediate left child of the sole & node; no storage or escape
range_proof.x: sole call passes gx; sole gx clamp is clamp(gx, 0, 4)

javascript_materialization_contract.range: render-reachable row is 0..31 and x is 0..4, hence count is 0..4
javascript_materialization_contract.narrowing: the shipped factory uses native JavaScript >> and &, which ToInt32 both operands and produce a signed int32 Number
javascript_materialization_contract.shift: native >> is arithmetic/sign-propagating; >>> is not used
javascript_materialization_contract.render_equivalence_boundary: because render-reachable row is nonnegative, >> and >>> are pixel-equivalent; direct signed fixtures are authoritative for the language distinction
javascript_materialization_contract.cpp_scope: admit the exact authenticated nonnegative node only; this oracle does not authorize general negative signed right shift
javascript_materialization_contract.texture_coordinates: GLSL fragment coordinates are bottom-left while Surface/comparer diagnostics are top-down

numeric_narrowing.semantics: ECMAScript bitwise operands truncate toward zero, reduce modulo 2^32, expose signed ToInt32 or unsigned ToUint32 numeric views over the same low word, and map nonfinite values to zero.

semantics.operand_narrowing: JavaScript bitwise operators apply ToInt32 to the left/mask operands; records begin from exact low-32-bit words and expose the signed Number views.
semantics.shift_count: JavaScript applies ToUint32 to the count and masks it with 31, including negative and counts >= 32.
semantics.result: Both >> and & produce signed int32 Number results; word fields preserve their exact two-complement bits.
semantics.materialization_order: (row >> count) & mask; shifting the masked row is a distinct rejected computation.
